crossRefs.note: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

translations.web: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
translations.bsb: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
translations.kjv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
translations.asv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.
